by_level_1: issuetype in ("Epic") AND project = PROJ ORDER BY updated DESC
by_level_2: issuetype in ("Feature","Bug","Issue") AND project = PROJ ORDER BY updated DESC
by_level_3_noproj: issuetype in ("Task") ORDER BY updated DESC
due_this_week: duedate >= startOfDay() AND duedate <= endOfWeek() AND status != Done AND project = PROJ ORDER BY duedate ASC
due_soon: duedate >= startOfDay() AND duedate <= 7d AND status != Done AND project = PROJ ORDER BY duedate ASC
assigned_to_me: assignee = currentUser() AND status != Done ORDER BY statusCategory DESC, duedate ASC, updated DESC
created_by_me: reporter = currentUser() ORDER BY created DESC
children_of: parent = PROJ-7 ORDER BY created ASC
by_label: labels = "ready" AND project = PROJ ORDER BY updated DESC
by_status: status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC
by_project: project = PROJ ORDER BY updated DESC
combine_noorder: (project = PROJ) AND (status = Done) ORDER BY updated DESC
by_duedate: duedate is not EMPTY AND project = PROJ ORDER BY duedate ASC
combine: (project = PROJ) AND (assignee = currentUser()) ORDER BY updated DESC
assigned_not_created: assignee = currentUser() AND reporter != currentUser() AND status != Done ORDER BY statusCategory DESC, duedate ASC, updated DESC
overdue: duedate < now() AND status != Done AND project = PROJ ORDER BY duedate ASC
due_today: duedate = startOfDay() AND status != Done AND project = PROJ ORDER BY duedate ASC
